STYLE: deliberately clustered crisp PIXEL ART, stepped dark outlines, matching image 2's pixel density, restrained colors and top-left lighting. Avoid glossy smooth illustration, 3D or airbrushed detail. Preserve readable material planes.
One complete isolated unit, actual transparent alpha, NO base, ground shadow, scenery, lettering or extra objects. All weapon tips, cape edges and feet fully inside canvas with at least 4% clear transparent margin. Center on BODY, not weapon. Finish all connected limbs and weapon grips cleanly.
